description: This file contains shell functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures in an embedded Linux system, including image verification, partition management, EFI system partition handling, and upgrade logic.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a system image by comparing partition layouts before and after extraction.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a specified partition on the device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates the EFI System Partition (ESP) with new EFI boot files from the image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade procedure handling partition updates, image deployment, and filesystem modifications.
